caption:
What if your child’s first investment was in SpaceX? 👀

Elon Musk’s reported plan to give SpaceX shares to children in America raises a bigger question about the future of money.

If AI and robots end up doing most of our jobs, will earning a salary still be enough? Or will owning a piece of the companies creating that wealth become more important?

Because in a world where machines do the work, owning assets could matter more than earning a paycheck.

What do you think?
creator: financewithsharan
